appDescription: Play a personalized commute briefing with a queue of short spoken topics.

function.name: NEXT_BRIEFING_TOPIC
function.description: Skip the current commute briefing topic and move to the next topic in the active queue.

function.name: PAUSE_COMMUTE_BRIEFING
function.description: Pause the current commute briefing and remember the playback position.

function.name: RESUME_COMMUTE_BRIEFING
function.description: Resume the active commute briefing from its paused position.
